user.title: SAX Battery Configuration
user.description: Set up your SAX Battery system to integrate with Home Assistant.

data.battery_count: Select your number of batteries (1 to 3)

control_options.title: Control Options
control_options.description: Configure how you want Home Assistant to interact with your SAX Battery system. You can continue without selecting any of these options, this will just add the sensors. The added options here require you to contact SAX's customer service.

data.control_power: Control battery from Home Assistant replacing the SAX smartmeter (you need registers 41 and 42 set to write)
data.limit_power: Enable power limitations (you need registers 43 and 44 to be writable). Once setup, you can create automations that send the proper values to this number entity with your own rules

data_description.control_power: Enable mode to control battery charge/discharge power (registers 41, 42)
data_description.limit_power: Enable power limits to set max charge/discharge (registers 43, 44)

power_options.title: Power Management Options
power_options.description: Configure power management options. Select whether a SAX smart meter is connected via RS485 and configure intelligent balanced loading.

data.sm_connected: SAX smart meter connected via RS485

data_description.sm_connected: Enable if the SAX smart meter is connected to the battery via RS485. When disabled, an external grid power sensor can be configured for balanced loading
data_description.balanced_loading: Enable balanced loading using an external grid power sensor. Negative grid power (production/export to grid) indicates surplus power available for charging — this typically means solar photovoltaic (PV) energy is available. Positive grid power (consumption/import from grid) means no surplus is available. Manual grid charging is always available independently

sensors.title: Power Monitoring Sensors
sensors.description: Select the sensors that monitor your home's power usage for intelligent battery control.

data_description.power_sensor: Select the grid power sensor entity. Negative values (W) indicate power production/export to grid (typically from solar PV), positive values indicate power consumption/import from grid

priority_devices.title: Priority Devices Setup
priority_devices.description: Select devices that will get priority over the battery. If power above 50W is detected battery will neither charge nor discharge. This is typically an EV charger.

data.priority_devices: Priority Devices, if enabled, battery will not discharge or charge

data_description.priority_devices: Select devices that should have priority over battery usage (e.g., EV charger, heat pump)

battery_config.title: Battery Connection Settings
battery_config.description: Configure network settings for {battery_count} SAX batteries. Battery A (L1), Battery B (L2), Battery C (L3)

data_description.battery_a_host: IP address or hostname for Battery A
data_description.battery_a_port: Modbus TCP port for Battery A (default: 502)
data_description.battery_b_host: IP address or hostname for Battery B
data_description.battery_b_port: Modbus TCP port for Battery B (default: 502)
data_description.battery_c_host: IP address or hostname for Battery C
data_description.battery_c_port: Modbus TCP port for Battery C (default: 502)
data_description.master_battery: Select which battery acts as master (polls smart meter)

init.title: SAX Battery Options
init.description: Update your SAX Battery configuration settings.

data.sm_connected: SAX smart meter connected via RS485

data_description.control_power: Enable or disable power control mode (registers 41,42)
data_description.sm_connected: Enable if the SAX smart meter is connected to the battery via RS485. When disabled, an external grid power sensor can be configured for balanced loading
data_description.balanced_loading: Enable balanced loading using an external grid power sensor. Negative grid power (production/export) indicates surplus available for charging, typically from solar PV. Positive grid power (consumption/import) means no surplus
